sync.headline: Today (Thu 11/12) the Finance Catchup with Andy at 1:30 runs straight over the Byga hold at 2:00, which you still haven't answered; bonuses have to be submitted tomorrow for the 11/15 payout. Sunday 11/15 carries three things at once — the supply-vs-demand dashboard and zones 1–2 of Jan–Mar to Andy, and your visit to the Rec session at Pier 40 — and Wednesday 11/18 is Media Day at Socceroof with Kyle away, on the same day as Soccer For All (noon), the Paychex underwriting-decision call (12:30, overlapping) and Ops Weekly. Moving: the 9/30 reconciliation (Nirmala's sources are now clear; the receivable still has to be built) and healthcare. Stuck or slipping: the Jan–March winter schedule announcement waits on final spaces (LREI with Mal, Immaculate Conception with you — Playbook demo 11/23), the COI renewal is due before 11/24, and three of your cards are past their dates — the review of Kyle's Decision & Ownership Guide (11/10), the parent FAQ and the Select Teams invite (both 11/11).

themes.name: Finance reset
themes.text: The 11/9 session with Nirmala settled where the 9/30 numbers come from (bank feed into QuickBooks, gross including fees; pay-to-date report with no receivables), so the next move is KP's: check her formulas and links and build the 9/30 receivable from total fee payable and installment plans. Bonuses go in Fri 11/13 (Kristen, Noemi, Nirmala), the audit draft is due around 11/16 ahead of the Dec 8 board meeting, and the finance-hire search and Sept/Oct expense catch-up still need owners.

themes.name: Payroll & healthcare
themes.text: Tuesday's catch-up with Andy set the rule that no full-time employee is paid hourly — the bonus plan covers extra time — which now needs writing into the handbook and communicating to the community-programming staff it affects; neither has an owner yet. Paul runs healthcare: Paychex presents the underwriting decision Wed 11/18 at 12:30, then plan selection and open enrollment for Jan 1.

themes.name: Winter indoor space
themes.text: The 11/11 Ops call asked where space is over-booked and listed what must be finalized before the Jan–March schedule is announced: LREI (Mal), Immaculate Conception School (KP, Playbook demo 11/23), PS 161 as a futsal-only option and Basis if Jesse wants it. KP owes Andy the supply-vs-demand dashboard and zones 1–2 by Sunday 11/15 and the COI renewal HRPT needs before 11/24; Leanne's December schedule is still marked 'Follow up'.

themes.name: Media Day & Kyle's leave
themes.text: Media Day is Wed 11/18 at Socceroof, 4–7pm, with Kyle out until 11/28: the venue contact and owner items are done, and what remains is KP's — Randy and Christina need the date and location, the teams email to Ops, Alex and Jason, the schedule of teams and Leo's assets. KP's review of Kyle's Decision & Ownership Guide was due 11/10 and is still open.

themes.name: Vendors: Soccer Post, Adidas, Byga

About $6,000 of promo expires Dec 15 and KP still has to test the coach-gear checkout; Byga's hold today at 2:00 is unanswered.

themes.name: Rec, marketing & systems
themes.text: KP joins the Rec/Class/Camp weekly call from Tue 11/17 after observing Rec on 11/15, still owing Oumou's group the program review, college-coach intros, media contacts and list access. The 11/11 call with Syd laid out marketing nobody owns — print listings, paid social, the unused $10K-a-month Google Ad Grant, registration links — on a $25K budget; the parent FAQ, Club Calendar, Select Teams, Advanced Camps and Criollo Bros meetings are all still open on KP's side.
